title: Local GitHub CI workflow and quality-gate contract

gates.G1_requirements: EF-107 is the next Phase 1 task after independently verified EF-106 and EF-106-C1 evidence.

G3_execution_authorization.scope: EF-107 only; no commit, push, deployment, or later task.

objective: Create a local, reviewable GitHub Actions CI workflow that runs EstateFlow's established quality gates and uses the already-isolated ephemeral test stack for integration tests, without publishing or running a destructive database test locally.

context.repository_state: not a Git repository; workflow is created locally only
context.test_target: CI only: Docker Compose project estateflow-test, PostgreSQL estateflow_test on loopback 55433, ephemeral tmpfs; cleanup always removes volumes
context.known_tooling: act is unavailable locally; GitHub Actions runtime is not emulated

forbidden: No git init, commit, remote, push, GitHub API/CLI action, PR, release, or deployment.
No local Docker start or local pnpm test:integration run; do not mutate estateflow_test locally.
No package/dependency/lockfile change, source code change, auth/secret/env-file change, production service, or workflow beyond this one CI file.
No credentials, token, hardcoded database URL/password, or non-test database target in CI YAML.

workflow_contract.runner: ubuntu-latest; checkout; setup Node 24.14.1; enable Corepack; pnpm 10.33.2; pnpm install --frozen-lockfile
workflow_contract.quality_steps: pnpm lint; pnpm typecheck; pnpm test; pnpm generate:openapi; pnpm check:openapi-drift; pnpm build; pnpm format:check
workflow_contract.integration: CI starts infra test compose, waits only for declared healthchecks, passes DATABASE_URL and ALLOW_DESTRUCTIVE_TESTS=1 only to pnpm test:integration, and always runs infra:test:down in a cleanup step with if: always().
workflow_contract.security: Use GitHub-provided environment only; no secret context access; no package publishing; no cache poisoning or remote writable action. Pin external actions to full commit SHA where action use is needed.

tdd: Write workflow verifier tests first; RED must fail because the workflow/verifier is absent.

Implement minimal static verifier that parses only the expected CI contract and rejects missing trigger/permissions, unpinned actions, absent cleanup, absent frozen install, absent required commands, and unsafe local database target literals.
GREEN: run verifier test and verifier against the committed local YAML.
acceptance: The workflow is syntactically valid YAML by a local parser-free structural verifier and is explicit about each quality command.
It restricts permissions to read-only contents and pins external action references to full commit SHA; no secrets context or credential literal appears.
Integration test is CI-only and targets only estateflow_test with cleanup guaranteed after success/failure; it never runs against local/dev production-like state.
Local verifier tests cover acceptance and negative failures for at least unpinned action, missing always-cleanup, and unsafe DB target.
Root lint/typecheck/test/build/format remain PASS; no local Docker/integration execution is performed.
Task docs record EF-107 executor evidence and require independent verification before Phase 2.
verification: static scan proves no `secrets.` and no database URL/credential literals in the workflow.
pnpm lint; pnpm typecheck; pnpm test; pnpm build; pnpm format:check. Do not run pnpm test:integration or docker compose.
